Hero_Desc_EdRehab:
ED has climbed down from Nata and begun walking on her own two feet.
Walking alone still feels unfamiliar, but she practices steadily.
At the end of a long nightmare, her unsteady steps slowly advance toward morning.
Album_Like_EdRehab: Mute, time spent with her sisters
Album_Wish_EdRehab: To stand back up whenever she falls
Album_EdRehab1: To overcome the heartbreak of parting with Nata, ED decided to step down from the life-support robot. I cannot easily imagine how she feels, but I will support her as she learns to stand on her own.
Album_EdRehab2: ED says she was confused when she first faced Nata after she became Mute, but has now accepted how Nata has changed. She often visits the banquet hall so they can share all the stories that accumulated between them.
Album_EdRehab3: One day, the three of us practiced walking together with Miro. ED can walk reasonably well now, though Miro remains unsteady. Having both experienced living inside worlds of their own, they seem to get along well.
Album_EdRehab4: Since climbing down from Nata, ED has been looking for part-time work. She does not want Xion to carry the burden of her living expenses forever.
Album_EdRehab5: ED says she has reconsidered how to face parting, a concept that became unfamiliar after coming to Elias... If the day comes when I must part from the Apostles, could I accept it as ED has?
Album_EdRehab6: ED says she no longer suffers the nightmares that once came every night. She misses sharing dreams with Nata, but dreams now help her remember reality and the present while holding hope for the future.
Album_EdRehab7: I asked ED whether she still dreamed of eternity. She said that instead of clinging to an eternal dream world, she has decided to treasure the present moment.
LoveHero_EdRehab: Thank you for believing in me. I will work even harder from now on...!
LoveHeroCancel_EdRehab: If you ever think of me again someday... please come and find me whenever you like.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Hate1: She frowned, saying cinnamon's bitter flavor remained an obstacle she could not overcome.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Hate2: She rejected it completely, saying it would keep her from sleeping properly, let alone having pleasant dreams.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Like1: The scent of grape juice reminds her of sharing it with Nata and makes her feel as though she is having a wonderful dream.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Like10: She smiled, saying the vivid flavor made her feel as though a dream had come true.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Like2: Perhaps because Nata liked it as a way to refuel, she appeared lost in deep memories for some time.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Like3: She said eating it herself instead of through a tube was fun, then carefully chewed each rice cake.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Like4: Calling it like a steadfast tree that never changes, she gazed at it with shining eyes for a long time before eating carefully.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Like5: The sourness was difficult for ED, who dislikes tart food. She asked whether I could dilute it with plenty of water, as Nata once did.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Like6: Amused by the round, smooth texture, she placed it in her mouth and playfully rolled it around.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Like7: She happily said the sweet, gentle aroma made her feel secure enough to sleep well tonight.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Like8: When told it was essential for recovering her health, she ate diligently with a look of firm determination.
Food_ChefNote_EdRehab_Like9: She stared as though enchanted by the many colors, fascinated because they resembled an entertaining dream world.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_EdRehab: The nightmare I feared... is over now.
Gacha_Result_Line1_EdRehab: Now... I will move forward on my own.
EdRehab_Spawn1: Is it time for me to awaken?
EdRehab_Spawn2: Now I can move forward on my own.
EdRehab_Growth1: It feels as though I have welcomed a new morning.
EdRehab_Growth2: I can take one more step forward.
EdRehab_Victory1: I won? Through my own strength?
EdRehab_Victory2: Mute, did you see that? I did it!
EdRehab_Defeat2: Was it still too much for me...?
EdRehab_Affinity1_1: I feel there is so much I can learn from you, Master.
EdRehab_Affinity1_2: It is still difficult for me to walk alone. Would you walk with me?
EdRehab_Affinity2: Why does Aya live in such a difficult place to climb to?
EdRehab_Affinity1_3: I will work hard at my rehabilitation again today.
EdRehab_Affinity3: This time, I want to win through my own strength. I can do it, right?
EdRehab_Affinity4: Ever since I became able to walk, everything looks new to me.
EdRehab_Affinity5: I am going to try being close with Mute again, like we used to be.
EdRehab_Affinity6: My sisters must be hoping I recover soon too, right?
EdRehab_Affinity7: Whether inside a dream or outside it, you are always on my side, Master.
EdRehab_Die1: I suppose now is not the time.
EdRehab_Die2: I will come back when I am a little healthier.
EdRehab_LevelUp: So this is what it feels like to have life flowing through me.
EdRehab_HeroSkill: This feeling of stretching out my feet and moving forward...
EdRehab_HeroUpgrade: It feels like a dream coming true.
EdRehab_Board: ...I can move forward on my own now.
EdRehab_DeckSetting1: Who will I be with today?
EdRehab_Stage: I will walk forward on my own.
EdRehab_Touch1: Ngh... Why are you doing this to me?
EdRehab_Touch1_1: If you keep this up, I will tell Mute everything.
EdRehab_Touch2_1: Hmm, this makes me feel happy.
EdRehab_Touch1_2: Is this what the pain of reality feels like?
EdRehab_Touch2: It feels somehow soft and warm.
EdRehab_Touch2_2: I think I will have a pleasant dream tonight.
EdRehab_DutchRubEnd2: I only just woke from my dream...
Item_HeroSkin_Desc_EdRehab_Skin1: ED (Rehabilitation) hurries to school. To avoid being late, she runs from the early morning with toast held in her mouth.
EdRehab_Growth1_Skin1: At this pace, I will just barely make it in time.
EdRehab_Growth2_Skin1: I am ready! I need to get going!
EdRehab_LevelUp_Skin1: Let us keep running forward with all our strength.
EdRehab_Equipment_Skin1: One bite of toast! I feel stronger already.
EdRehab_HeroSkill_Skin1: The light turned green! How lucky.
EdRehab_HeroUpgrade_Skin1: I arrived on time! Made it, hehe!
EdRehab_Board_Skin1: I know a shortcut that will get us there faster.
EdRehab_Touch1_Skin1: Uagh! You nearly made me drop my breakfast toast!
EdRehab_Touch1_1_Skin1: Ngh~ I will be late at this rate!
EdRehab_Touch1_2_Skin1: You can just wake up earlier next time.
EdRehab_Touch2_Skin1: ...I will be late if I do not hurry...
EdRehab_Touch2_1_Skin1: I suppose it cannot be helped. Shall we walk for a while?
EdRehab_Touch2_2_Skin1: I feel good from the moment morning begins.
EdRehab_DutchRubEnd2_Skin1: If you keep doing this, I will stop talking to you!
EdRehab_Growth1_Skin2: I may still be inexperienced, but I am steadily improving.
EdRehab_Growth2_Skin2: This is Culturetium 25, growing together with our customers.
EdRehab_LevelUp_Skin2: So there was a way to do this! I learned a new trick!
EdRehab_Equipment_Skin2: Double POS register... Xion said this was how to do it...
EdRehab_HeroSkill_Skin2: No discrepancies in the register totals. Today is a happy day.
EdRehab_HeroUpgrade_Skin2: At this rate, becoming a manager is only a matter of time.
EdRehab_Board_Skin2: Where should I put away today's new arrivals?
EdRehab_Touch1_1_Skin2: No matter what you do, I cannot give you another discount.
EdRehab_Touch1_Skin2: Please do not do that during working hours.
EdRehab_Touch2_1_Skin2: Are you praising me for doing well?
EdRehab_Touch1_2_Skin2: Ngh... When is the next part-timer coming to relieve me...?
EdRehab_Touch2_2_Skin2: A break like this is not so bad.
EdRehab_Touch2_Skin2: I am still on the clock.
EdRehab_DutchRubEnd2_Skin2: If you do that again, I will have to follow the manual.
Aside_Get_EdRehab1: Precious memories... Let us keep making more together.
Aside_Upgrade_EdRehab1: We will welcome it together. A new morning.
EdRehab_AsideGet: Precious memories... Let us keep making more together.
EdRehab_AsideUpgrade: We will welcome it together. A new morning.
EdRehab_SPSkill1: This is a dream made manifest!
EdRehab_Ultimate1: It is time to wake from the dream.
EdRehab_Ultimate3: Now I will face it on my own!
EdRehab_Birthday: Happy birthday. I hope you have a wonderful day.
EdRehab_Gacha2: Now I will move forward on my own.
EdRehab_Gacha3: That frightening nightmare is over now.
EdRehab_Line1: Mute, give me the strength to move forward on my own.
EdRehab_Line2: Leaving my dreaming soul behind, I will move forward.
EdRehab_Line3: I am no longer a girl who turns away from reality and escapes into dreams.
EdRehab_Lobby: Even if reality is painful, I have to face it.
EdRehab_EasterEgg_MuteWith: A-ahem, I am all right. I was only startled. Thank you for helping me, Mute.
EdRehab_EasterEgg_Party: I will walk with you, toward the morning we will welcome together.
EdRehab_Theme_Ed_WakeUp_Desc: Touch ED to wake her up.
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text1: Voice log recording. Ahem. Ah, ah. C-can you hear me, ED?
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text2: This is my first time leaving a voice recording like this, so it feels a little awkward. Haha.
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text3: ED and I have never exchanged anything like letters before, have we?
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text4: So... I wanted to leave this voice recording as a kind of letter.
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text5: ...ED, it has already been quite some time since you woke from your dream.
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text6: How is life in reality? I have been helping too, but it is still difficult to adjust, is it not?
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text7: Yes, I am sure it is still difficult. But ED...
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text8: I am truly happy that you have begun living in reality.
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text9: ED, I do not know how long we will be able to stay together, but...
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text10: The dreams we shared, which will someday remain as memories...
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text11: Even if they are dreams from which you must eventually awaken, all of them will give you strength.
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text12: So that you can say you had a good dream and greet a dazzling morning.
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text13: ...Haha! Here I am saying all sorts of strange things for no reason.
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text14: ED. Whatever decision you make, I will be by your side.
EdRehab_Theme_Nata_Text15: I am always cheering for you. So... keep going! My dearest friend.
EdRehab_Theme_Popup1_Desc1: I know it will be hard, but I hope you will not give up. The day will surely come when all your effort is rewarded, ED!
EdRehab_Theme_Popup1_Desc2: Even when we turned away from an uncertain reality... at least within our dreams, we could always live without fear. Because we had each other.
EdRehab_Theme_Popup2_Desc1: You are having another nightmare... I wish you did not have to suffer through them...
EdRehab_Theme_Popup2_Desc2: Whenever you had trouble falling asleep, I would sing you a lullaby, clumsy though it was. Because I wanted the dreams you had... to be happy ones.
EdRehab_Theme_Popup3_Desc1: U-uwah?! Ugh... It seems walking is still very difficult for you.
EdRehab_Theme_Popup3_Desc2: In our dreams, we could do anything. We never tired no matter how long we ran, and it seemed that our footsteps would continue forever.
EdRehab_Theme_Popup4_Desc1: It is wonderful to see you working so hard! Endure it even when it hurts, ED!
EdRehab_Theme_Popup4_Desc2: We used to have so much fun together in our dreams. Watching the flowers beneath the warm sunlight... It is a very precious memory.
EdRehab_Theme_Standing_Pinch_Desc: Pull ED's cheeks or stroke her head to wake her up.
EdRehab_Theme_Standing_Pinch_Desc2: Pull ED's cheeks or stroke her head. {0} time(s)
EdRehab_Theme_Standing_Turn_Desc: Drag ED to turn her around.
LoveLetter_EdRehab:
Hello, Master!
These days, I am happier than I have ever been.
After successfully climbing Elemental Mountain, I regained so much confidence too!

Now I understand clearly that this Elias beneath my own two feet is no longer a dream.
That makes me even happier. Reality does not always go as I wish, and sometimes I feel hurt or disappointed, but I have decided to treat those moments as steps that help me grow. I will visit you soon, Master. I hope we can walk side by side and take another stroll, just as before!
LoveCall_EdRehab:
Master, have you been well?
I contacted you today because...
Hmm... If you have time, would you like to take a walk with me?

The ground beneath my first steps after waking from that long sleep was colder and harder than I imagined.
The injuries from every fall hurt and sometimes frightened me,
but whenever that happened, you were beside me to catch me, Master,
and gave me the courage to take another step.

So today, I want to go a little farther than usual.
If you came with me, I would feel much safer.

Thank you for always walking beside me and matching my pace.
Then I will be waiting, Master.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP01_001: Is there a good way to relieve muscle pain?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP01_002: How about applying a warm towel?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP01_003: But Xion always heats the towel far too much...
Affinity_EdRehab_EP01_004: It is better to combine rehabilitation with rest than to push yourself too hard.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP01_005: ...You mean that proper rest is essential for a better recovery.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP01_006: That pain is the very sign of muscle growth. At a time like this, one more set of squats would...
Affinity_EdRehab_EP01_007: Ah... Aah... I need to get out of here quickly...
Affinity_EdRehab_EP02_001: Huff, huff... Could I have a glass of water?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP02_002: ...Can you make it all the way home from here?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP02_003: Ah... Now that I think about it, I must walk back along the entire road I took to get here... Aah...
Affinity_EdRehab_EP02_006: You worked hard to make it this far.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP02_007: Yes. I walked here as part of my rehabilitation... It was difficult, but it feels rewarding.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP03_001: ...What foods can I eat without gaining weight?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP03_003: The one Xion sometimes brings home after work? It should be all right to eat, should it not?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP03_005: Even if they are carrots, they are still fried. Would they not make me gain weight?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP03_007: Ugh... If it is for my health, I should be able to endure the taste, right?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP04_001: Chloe wants to make me a gift to commemorate my rehabilitation. What should I ask her to make?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP04_002: Walk around together and choose something you like.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP04_003: I do not yet have enough stamina to walk around anywhere.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP04_004: Ask her to make you a pretty outfit for going out.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP04_005: That is a good idea. I spent so long inside the life-support device that I do not have many clothes for going out.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP04_006: How about a doll shaped like Nata?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP04_007: ...If I sleep while hugging it, I should have pleasant dreams, right?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP05_001: Lady Hilde says I have recovered a great deal.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP05_002: Then how about moving from bodyweight exercises to weight training?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP05_003: Hmm... I do not think I am ready for that yet.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP05_004: Does that mean your treatment is moving to the next stage?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP05_005: I think I can endure the current intensity... It will not hurt too much or be too difficult, will it?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP05_006: Soon you will be able to walk around without a walking aid, right?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP05_007: I hope the day when I can walk under my own power comes soon.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP06_001: Once I become a little healthier, I want to visit other places too.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP06_003: I went there often... I would like to visit somewhere else.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP06_005: That sounds good. I think I could also revisit the memories I made there with Nata.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP06_007: Would walking through a swamp not still be too difficult for me...? I am absolutely not saying that because I am worried about dirtying my clothes.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP07_001: I heard that Witches drink stimulants to avoid sleeping. Why do they drink them?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP07_002: Because they have so much to do while awake.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP07_003: No matter how important their work is, can it truly be important enough to sacrifice sleep?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP07_004: At the same time, what they desire most is a proper night's sleep.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP07_005: They want to sleep, yet drink something that prevents them from sleeping... I cannot understand it.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP07_006: ED, you should try it too.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP07_007: No matter how hard I try to live in reality, I still want to dream naturally.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP08_001: I do not think I have had a nightmare lately.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP08_002: Could it be because your body is exhausted?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP08_003: On days when I do my rehabilitation exercises, I seem to fall asleep as though I had fainted.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP08_004: ...Are you disappointed that you cannot have nightmares?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP08_005: Of course not! Who would want to have nightmares?!
Affinity_EdRehab_EP08_006: Could it be because there are more happy things in your life?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP08_007: I hope days like these continue from now on.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP09_001: Maestro challenged me to a word-chain contest.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP09_002: ...I will tell you a guaranteed way to win. Zirconium. Memorize it.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP09_003: What is that? I do not understand.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP09_004: You cannot defeat an AI at a word-chain game. Is there another way?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP09_005: The only thing I am especially good at is sleeping for a long time... Could I defeat Maestro with that?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP09_006: Could Maestro be trying to settle the contest that never ended with Nata?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP09_007: If so, I will face Maestro with all my strength. Please cheer for me, Master.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP10_001: If Mute dreams too, what sort of dreams would they be?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP10_003: No! Mute is not the same Mute from the past!
Affinity_EdRehab_EP10_004: Mute is a spirit. Does a spirit dream?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP10_005: Nata dreamed before becoming Mute, so would Mute not still dream now?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP10_006: A happy dream together with ED.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP10_007: I want to have a happy dream together with Mute too.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP11_001: I am practicing walking diligently, but I am afraid I might fall.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP11_002: That is why you should have left the Nata model sooner.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP11_003: You are right. In the end, it was my fault.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP11_004: I will watch carefully so you do not fall, so do not be too afraid.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP11_005: Thank you. I nearly hesitated to continue rehabilitation because of something that has not even happened.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP11_006: If you do not mind, should I support you? Then you will not fall.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP11_007: I appreciate the thought, but I am all right. I need to practice walking under my own power.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP12_001: Someday I want to do something for Xion, who always takes care of me. What would be good?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP12_002: Earn money from a part-time job and give it to her as spending money.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP12_003: Good. I am truly looking forward to seeing her reaction.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP12_004: Join the darknet and complete its verification.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP12_005: Anything but that! I have no intention of worsening her condition.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP12_006: Be the first to give her a hug.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP12_007: I will try that when I return home today. Thank you for the advice.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP13_001: Sometimes I suddenly remember when I first parted with Nata, and my heart aches.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP13_002: Still, I am glad you seem all right now.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP13_003: Yes. Mute is beside me now.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP13_004: It is not as though you suffered an actual physical wound, right?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP13_005: ...Your result on the Elven basic personality-type classification would certainly be TTTT, Master.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP13_006: But that moment is what allowed you to stand upon your own two feet.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP13_007: Yes. If this is the person Nata hoped I would become, then I will continue moving forward with even greater determination.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP14_001: Look here. My sisters wrote messages on my walking aid saying they hope I will soon walk well.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP14_002: Once you can walk properly, that device will eventually be discarded. Is there any meaning in leaving messages on it?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP14_003: Somehow, that reminds me of when the Nata model rejected me...
Affinity_EdRehab_EP14_004: Oh, Mute's signature is here too.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP14_005: Yes. Mute wrote it the day before yesterday. There was not much room, yet the writing was remarkably neat.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP14_006: May I write that I hope you recover soon too?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP14_007: Of course, Master. You are more than welcome to.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP15_001: Whenever my sisters come noisily to visit me, I worry they might disturb the other patients in the ward.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP15_003: Hmm, I have been rather prickly toward them in the past, so I am a little worried.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP15_004: Perhaps the other patients receive your sisters' bright energy and become happier too?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP15_005: I would be very glad if the patients enjoy themselves because of my sisters, just as you say, Master.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP15_006: Hilde's hospital does not have many patients anyway, so it should not be a problem.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP15_007: Is it truly right to brush the issue aside for that reason...?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP16_001: How do you awaken on days when your dream is so sweet that you do not want to get up, Master?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP16_002: When Ner begins lecturing me, I have no choice but to get up.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP16_003: Are you certain you are all right? How about visiting the hospital together?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP16_004: Even in the dream, I remember that I should not sleep any longer, and that wakes me.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP16_005: It is impressive that you remain responsible even in your dreams, but I think you may be more forgiving toward yourself, Master.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP16_006: I am reluctant to wake, but when the morning sunlight falls upon me, my eyes open naturally.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP16_007: Even someone like you can become intoxicated by a dream, Master. Now that I consider it, that feels rather curious.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP17_001: Will the day ever come when I can walk properly without a walking aid?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP17_002: As long as you do not give up, it certainly will.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP17_003: I truly hope so. Until that day arrives, please continue watching over me.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP17_004: I hope that day comes soon, but you must not overexert yourself in practice.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP17_005: Understood. Lady Hilde and my sisters always emphasize the same thing.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP17_006: Ask Hilde about that. Would an expert not know best?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP17_007: Lady Hilde rarely tells me either... She must have a reason.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP18_001: Today Mute bought food outside. It tasted delicious while we ate and chatted together.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP18_002: Is space food not about the only thing one can buy to eat in Monatinum?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP18_003: There was some space food, but Mute bought other delicious dishes too.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP18_004: The weather was lovely today. Did you talk while looking at the scenery outside?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP18_005: Yes. Once I can walk even better than I do now, I want to suggest that we go on a picnic.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP18_006: Since you were going to eat, would it not have been better to visit Ricota Restaurant?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP18_007: That sounds good too. I should suggest it to Mute later.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP19_001: Once, I looked up at a night sky filled with stars from outside the hospital ward. It was incredibly beautiful.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP19_002: When a shooting star falls, I shall wish for ED to walk properly on two feet soon.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP19_003: Someday, I will be certain to make that wish come true.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP19_004: You did not mistake the lights of the buildings for stars, did you?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP19_005: N-No! What I saw truly were stars!
Affinity_EdRehab_EP19_006: I should choose a night and take some time to look at the sky too.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP19_007: I recommend it, Master. Emptying your thoughts and looking at the beautiful night sky and stars makes you feel better.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP20_001: ...I heard that Eternal Bullet exists in the future I dream of. Is Eternal Bullet truly the future I desire?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP20_002: You do not need to worry about it too much. All of that is merely a childish lie.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP20_003: A childish lie... I understand what you mean.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP20_004: You do not need to be so ashamed of your true self, Eternal Bullet.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP20_005: Ughhh, somehow I see Xion reflected in you, Master.
Affinity_EdRehab_EP20_006: Is what matters not that you and Xion are happily playing together?
Affinity_EdRehab_EP20_007: Now that you mention it, that is true. You always seem to notice and carefully point out the things I overlook, Master.
